title: Dreadwake's Dilemma: native kills and complete39154 branch coverage
status: Existing39153 code/data required kill and turn-in path passes selected native checks; no new production defect or World repair indicated. The regression/audit omission of third39154 predecessor39153 is corrected, with all three branches and all eight rewarded histories covered.
findings: 39153 is Horde quest Dreadwake's Dilemma: starter/ender Nathanos93603, previous38872, reward-next/NextQuestID39154. Its sole mandatory goal is279015/typeMONSTER0/entry94614/amount10/storageIndex2/flags0. The sparse slot2 is intentional data; it is not treated as slot0 because there is only one objective.

Native KilledMonster credits the actual template Entry with its victim GUID, then each nonzero KillCredit[] substitution.94614 has no alias to itself;93860,94825,109633 and109635 each have a single94614 alias. Each successful native reward therefore increases the39153 counter once, without a new SmartAI action or quest script.

The actual Unit::Kill owner selection, KillRewarder::_RewardPlayer/_RewardKillCredit, delayed50ms callback, Player::KilledMonster/KilledMonsterCredit, objective getters/setter, normal save marking and quest completion/reward-request handlers execute in the test. All five templates pass ten player kills and ten pet kills individually; a mixed-template pet run also completes10/10. An already rewarded victim is rejected by native per-player reward admission after its first callback.

The native objective setter writes ObjectiveData[2], marks the quest for save on a normal gain and requests quest-log counter2. A load-mode9/10 write does not dirty the quest; the next pet kill reaches10, dirties it and completes it. No ObjectiveData slots0/1 are silently substituted. The real SQL login/save and client fields remain fixture boundaries.

All five source templates have active98..110 scaling, ordinary attackable unit flags32768, no custom ScriptName or template SmartAI event rows, and no additional quest/source22 conditions. Infiltrator94825 retains flags2=33556480 (hide combat log plus regenerate power), not an invented immunity removal. Native faction2166 and2618 are hostile to Horde2 and nonhostile to Alliance1; giver118 is nonhostile to Horde2.

There are exactly two such rows and no associated source22 conditions. Native ProcessEvent UPDATE_OOC returns while me->isInCombat(); inspected. Typed168875 Cosmetic - Shoot C has one DUMMY3 effect, no aura/trigger/misc credit, targets46/91; there is no custom spell binding/dummy trigger/linked spell. This records the native cosmetic contract, not proof of its rendered shot or full AI execution. No death/damage/progression event is supplied by these two rows.

All34 outdoor map1220 source rows retain phaseMask1, empty PhaseId and model override0. Nine relevant display records and their native model files exist, as do World model-info rows. Typed native reader confirms Worgen/human variants63721/22/23/24/26/27/28/29 and Nathanos66644; no model metadata or spawn was invented.

The full World NextQuestID=39154 set is exactly38873,39153,39385, all ExclusiveGroup0. Own PrevQuestID39385 plus incoming predecessors are OR-admitted by the native loader/previous-quest code. Any one rewarded alternative admits39154;38872 alone or an active/unrewarded-complete alternative does not. Native chapter137 order0/1/2 is not evidence of an AND gate.

The Gift fixture originally omitted38873 and39153, and the Dreadwake follow-up added only38873. Their SQL exports already revealed39153 as an incoming row, but earlier tests did not enforce the exact incoming set or include its quest metadata. Both readers now load39153 and assert the exact three-ID set, so a future missing/unrepresented branch fails visibly. Both existing audit files retain original evidence/hashes and have explicit corrective followup fields.

geometry.limits: Static complete Detour corridors and supported nearby endpoints establish conservative access to these spawn anchors, not that live mobile enemies remain at those exact points. All34 selected endpoints also report unobstructed static rays. This is not continuous character-body clearance, encounter/combat AI, phase/UI availability or client traversal proof.

boundaries: This is a code/data audit, not a reported39153 client reproduction or full game-client verification. No new production failure was found, so no speculative quest/faction/credit rewrite was applied.

The full outer Unit::Kill, KillRewarder::Reward XP/reputation calculation and combat damage/AI execution are not instantiated. The actual selected owner/reward/group/quest functions are compiled, while world/ObjectAccessor lookup, death scheduling and eligibility inputs are fixtures. The two per-spawn OOC CAST events and their visual playback are inspected/data-validated rather than executed in the kill regression.

The actual native objective setter executes its normal MONSTER/non-storing-flag path. Criteria-tree and storing-flag behavior are fixture stubs and are not claimed covered. Quest-log fields/packets, dirty-save dispatch and actual database persistence remain fixture boundaries.

Saved9 state is reconstructed through the native setter load-mode branch, not through real character login. Acceptance calls the native AddQuestAndCheckCompletion wrapper but its AddQuest inventory/log setup is a fixture. Turn-in reward-offer admission is native; the subsequent rewarded-set change is simulated rather than a full SQL reward transaction.

Existing Nathanos npc_stormheim_fleet_actor delegates outside its map1475 mission; its ordinary outdoor quest service is preserved. All earlier Cullen flight/camera/pet, Gift underwater/detonator, shield/communion/movie and visual client checks remain pending in their own audits.
